dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Three prominent 'O' shaped rings in the mid-lateral section exhibit irregular, undulating circular geometries with sharp pixel transitions from the dark background to a light-colored perimeter. The most prominent structures show a distinct high-contrast gradient from the dark exterior into a high-intensity white band.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of amorphous low-intensity (dark) blobs located in the posterior region where annular structures merge. Isolated high-intensity pixel clusters are concentrated as solid cores within the smaller ring patterns on the anterior-lateral flank.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three largest central macro-annuli form an obtuse triangle with the longest side oriented vertically. A secondary cluster of four smaller annuli forms a sub-linear vertical chain approximately 150 pixels anterior to the primary triangle.
